description: This file implements the FundReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve fund data from a database, including fetching all funds and a specific fund by ID. It uses JDBC for database access and integrates with the Fineract platform's security context.

classes.name: FundReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the FundReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to access fund data via JDBC, with security context checks and caching.

classes.name: FundMapper
classes.description: A private static class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to FundData instances.

methods.name: retrieveAllFunds
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of all funds from the database, ordered by name. Uses caching and security context validation.

methods.name: retrieveFund
methods.description: Fetches and returns a specific fund by its ID. Throws FundNotFoundException if no such fund exists.
